reasoning_content: Let me use the fingerprint header.

action.command:
cd /workspace
curl -s -b /tmp/cookies.txt -c /tmp/cookies.txt --max-time 30 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/signin \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-CSRF-Token: $CSRF" \
  -H "X-Zammad-User-Fingerprint: test" \
  -d '{"username":"admin@example.com","password":"test"}' -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n" | tail -10
